row.name: Synox
row.description: A highly lethal neurotoxin, used as an odorless, tasteless powder, or liquid payload in toxic darts made for assassinations. If consumed, touched, or injected: Target makes HT-5, or poison resistance-5 related roll. On fail, deals 3d tox. Cyclic, 1 cycles per sec, target makes rerolls each cycle, until dead, unless treated using an Antidote Kit. On success, deals 1d tox, Cyclic, 1 cycles per min. On crit success, target takes 1d tox, Cyclic, 1 cycles per min.
